h: The Rod of Suffering Becomes a Staff of Consolation

p: ה׳ רוֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָר וְגוֹמֵר (תְּהִלִּים כג, א)
Hashem is my shepherd, I shall not lack," etc. (Tehillim 23:1);
In the Pesikta on this haftarah:
"'And Tziyon said: He has forsaken me':
for even of Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
making his son king in Egypt,
'My way is hidden from Hashem,'" etc.;
so I am destined to destroy Edom;
and you say, 'Hashem has forsaken me.'"
in the seven haftaros of consolation.
Although consolations are mentioned in it,
"Can a woman forget her nursing child?"
and we have not yet been saved;
and the earlier generations have already passed,
and they did not bring the redemption;
so what will be in this orphaned generation,
just as Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
Yosef would not have been king,
to keep them alive in the famine,
and he was fit to go down to Egypt
so too the whole exile of Yisrael
"You will be blessed above all the peoples";
"And I will sow her for Me in the land";
except to bring in many kor?"
specifically that converts will be added to them,
but rather to bring out of them
similar to what the Arizal wrote
עַל מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר בְּעֵשָׂו (בְּרֵאשִׁית כה, כח)
on what it says of Esav (Bereishis 25:28),
since the king of Edom sent him.
from the pasuk the child recited to him:
"And I will lay My vengeance upon Edom" (Yechezkel 25:14).
And this Yaakov took from Esav.
that it subjugates us among seventy nations,
and one is exiled to Samatria;
it is as though you were all exiled," etc.
And all that the exile is prolonged
is because there is still need
to bring the holiness out of them.
And then it will be seen
that everything was for the good of Yisrael;
and this is "Your rod and Your staff,
is a staff for the good;
